candidate.name: Microsoft Vösendorf data-center campus
candidate.status_review: The municipal August 13 update describes the current data-center construction site and construction traffic at Anton-Benya-Straße, with future permanent access via Fachmarktstraße. This is physical-site activity, not merely a scheduled groundbreaking.
candidate.identity_review: The municipality does not name Microsoft. Association with Microsoft is a geographic reconciliation against the operator site board on page 9, not a literal municipal attribution. The outlined Vösendorf campus is west of OBI/Triester Straße and south of A21. No municipality-to-operator name quotation is claimed.
candidate.project_scope: One Vösendorf campus, not Schwechat or Achau. A completed 2025 substation and prospective central data-center construction phases remain distinct; the page 10 provisional 2028 completion is not an actual completion event.

locator_review.reason: The operator board supplies a visible site outline but no parcel identifier, coordinate tuple or source CRS. Google background imagery is not traced into invented geometry. The independent locator review excludes a wrong southern construction feature, imprecise greenfield feature and street bounds.

successor_review.operator_dialogue: The operator explicitly links the reviewed board and describes three separate Lower Austrian sites at different stages, from construction preparation to operation. It does not assign one common status to all sites.
successor_review.region_opening: The July 2025 region-opening article does not name Vösendorf. Regional availability cannot establish completion of this specific campus.
successor_review.publication_date_caveat: The board filename and April upload-directory path do not establish an exact publication day.

pdf_review.method: Poppler rendered full pages; page numbers are one-based

rights_review.redistribution_scope: Only minimal attributed facts, capture metadata and independent review decisions are committed. No source PDF, publisher prose, code, photographs or map imagery is redistributed.

validation.independent_review: Maxwell independently inspected the operator and municipal identity/status evidence and the relevant board pages. Bohr separately reviewed exact-locator candidates; neither review admits a site.

next_action: Find an explicit project-bound parcel identifier or another exact, lawfully reusable locator with coordinate semantics; reconcile it to the operator board and municipal construction site before any admission.
